subject: Re: Scheduling — LLM pilot demo and next steps
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@prysmlabs.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <carlos@prysmlabs.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Reprioritizing our LLM pilot — request to pause scheduling

Hi Irene / Jordan,

Apologies for the short note — we've had a last-minute planning sync here at Prysm and the engineering leadership has pulled the upcoming sprint to focus on a cross-team data migration. As a result, the LLM pilot we were lining up with Redwood needs to move off the immediate roadmap.

Concretely: we need to cancel the demo scheduled for 2027-09-07 and put the pilot work into our backlog until the new sprint planning in Q4. The reasons are:
- Critical data ingestion work (customer-facing) bumped to the top of the list
- A hiring freeze for new infra work that impacts our ability to allocate a platform engineer
- Several key stakeholders (including Nora in procurement) are on extended travel next two weeks

We still like Redwood and want to re-engage, but at least for the next 6–10 weeks we won't be able to proceed. Can you confirm next steps for pausing the mutual action plan and any items we should hand off to our procurement team now?

Thanks — I'll loop in Nora for procurement.

Best,
Maya Patel
Head of Product
Prysm Labs

Attachments: none

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@prysmlabs.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reprioritizing our LLM pilot — request to pause scheduling

Hi Maya — thank you for the update and for the clear rationale. Totally understand — roadmap shifts happen.

Quick summary of what we will do on our side:
- Cancel the 2027-09-07 demo slot and mark the account paused in our pipeline.
- Freeze the current mutual action plan (MAP) and mark outstanding items as "on hold". I will generate a brief MAP pause document you can share with procurement.
- Keep your sandbox credentials active (read-only) and we will snapshot the environment so you can pick up quickly later.

If it helps, here are two options for re-engaging when you're ready:
1) Target a Q4 sprint planning touchpoint (we can tentatively pencil in week-of Oct 18) — we won't book a demo until you confirm capacity.
2) If you get a short window earlier, we can do a 30-minute async demo recording + Q&A thread so your travelling stakeholders can consume on their schedule.

Jordan / Ben — FYI on paused account; Ben, please keep an eye on this deal and follow up with a light pipeline touch in three weeks unless we hear otherwise.

Maya — I'll attach a one-page MAP pause summary and a short note on how to re-open the pilot when you have capacity.

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: MAP_pause_prysmlabs.pdf (PDF - 42KB)

From: Maya Patel <maya@prysmlabs.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Nora Singh <nora@prysmlabs.com>, Carlos Rivera <carlos@prysmlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reprioritizing our LLM pilot — request to pause scheduling

Thanks Irene — that sounds perfect.

Nora (procurement) — for your awareness, we're asking Redwood to pause the MAP and cancel the upcoming demo until we can confirm resourcing. Please let me know if you need anything from us to close the file on your end (PO/contract hold, vendor follow-up).

Irene — we prefer option #1 (aim for Q4) but don't pencil anything firm yet. We'll reach out once we lock sprint capacity. Also note: Carlos will be the point person for technical follow-ups while I'm traveling.

I'll reply here if anything changes sooner.

—Maya

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reprioritizing our LLM pilot — request to pause scheduling

Hi Maya / Nora — confirmed on our side.

Action items completed:
- Demo on 2027-09-07 cancelled and calendar invites removed.
- MAP paused and exported to PDF (attached).
- I've added a short "restart checklist" to the MAP that highlights the two things that most often block a re-start: engineer allocation and procurement window.
- Marked the HubSpot deal as "Paused — Roadmap Reprioritization" and set a 2027-10-18 reminder for a touchpoint.

Nora — if you'd like, we can place the proposed contract redline bundle in a single DocuSign envelope labeled "hold until Q4" so you have the paperwork ready; otherwise we'll wait for you to ask us to re-open.

We'll keep the sandbox snapshot available until 2027-12-31 for quick spin-up. If Prysm wants to accelerate earlier, we can provide a recorded 20-minute demo and a short onboarding checklist for travelling stakeholders.

Thanks for the transparency — we'll be here when you are ready.

Regards,
Irene

Attachments: MAP_pause_prysmlabs.pdf (PDF - 42KB); SLA_review_notes.txt (TXT - 3KB)
